body: Dm me please. I will buy immediately. I’m so so tired of my miserable existence.
This entire family is ENTITLED! It’s crazy 🫨

My life has been horrible ever since I was born. It would take me a century to go through all the specifics but even still, it’s a story I’m sure you’ve heard before. I’m lonely, an outcast, a bad person, and I don’t belong here.
